C1579.title: Data Poisoning Attacks on Wearable Devices in IoT: Detection Research
C1579.summary: This research highlights that machine learning models used for human activity recognition in IoT ecosystems such as smart homes and healthcare are vulnerable to data poisoning attacks. Attackers can manipulate model decisions and affect system functionality by contaminating training data.
